03 / LAYERS FOUR SOVEREIGN LAYERS

No layer trusts another with more than it needs. That is what makes the loop sovereign: apps never hold keys, custodians never go online, governance weight is soulbound and never for sale, and AI never acts outside its charter.

04 / JOURNEY ONE MESSAGE, SEVEN STOPS

“gm” travels the whole loop in seconds

Nothing in this sequence trusts a company. Each stop does one job and hands off — that is the entire security model.

01
USER · SOVEREIGNYou type “gm” in Engine, 9:41

Two letters. Sovereign by the time they arrive.

02
VAULT · TEEYour fingerprint authorizes a signature

The private key never wakes outside secure silicon. A challenge-response signature rides back through IPC, fresh within ±120 seconds.

03
ENGINE · RAMMessage sealed end-to-end

ECDH shared key + AES-256-GCM with AAD binding. The app holds it in memory only — no disk, no database, no cloud.

04
📡 RELAY · STATELESSA blind courier forwards ciphertext

Challenge-response registered, sequence numbers monotonic. It routes frames it cannot read, stores nothing, and forgets you instantly.

05
SPARK · METERFuel is metered and burned

Two letters cost a sliver of $SPARK under the 40KB text budget. Expression is energy — literally accounted.

06
AETHER · RESERVEA governed share banks into the reserve

Burned fuel feeds the long-term $SPARK reserve — three chambers, 3/5 multisig, public timelock. Nobody's impulse moves it.

07
HAVIX · CHARTERA chartered AI rebalances the pools

AI keeps liquidity flowing between reserve and app-side fuel pools — inside hard limits, with receipts, red lines routed to human votes. The loop closes; tomorrow's “gm” is already funded.

06 / WEB3 → WEB4

Web3 gave you keys. Web4 gives keys a constitution.

Owning your keys is not enough if the economy around you is still run by unaccountable intermediaries — human or machine. The loop closes that gap: value flows are public, reserves are SBT-governed, and AI autonomy is bounded by a charter anyone can audit.
